Welcome to the Pokedex!
Usage:

catch <pokemon_name>: Attempt to catch a Pokémon by name
exit: Exit the Pokedex
explore <area_name>: Displays the names of all Pokémon found in a given area
help: Displays a help message
map: Displays the names of 20 location areas in the Pokemon world
mapb: Displays the names of 20 location areas in the Pokemon world but in backward direction
